kicker.zh: 开发中 · 从一次模型调用搭起编码 agent
kicker.en: In development · A coding agent from one model call

lede.zh: 编码 agent 里面是什么？从一次模型调用开始，亲手决定它看到什么、能做什么、什么时候算做完：先替它拿文件，再让它自己读、自己找、改到测试通过。最后搭出的，是一个自己接 issue、自己修好的 agent。
lede.en: What is inside a coding agent? Starting from one model call, you decide what it sees, what it may do and when it is done: first you fetch its files, then it reads and looks for itself, and goes on until the tests pass. What you end up with is an agent that takes an issue and fixes it on its own.

question.en: What does the model actually see?

question.zh: 只能问一次，要给它看什么？
question.en: One call only: what do you show it?

question.zh: 让它自己去拿，什么时候停？
question.en: Let it fetch for itself: when does it stop?

text.zh: src/cart.js 的 addItem：数量为 0 的商品不应该加进购物车。
text.en: addItem in src/cart.js: an item of quantity 0 should not go into the cart.

title.en: Removing an item that is not there

text.zh: src/cart.js 的 removeItem：删一件购物车里没有的商品时，应该什么都不做，现在会报错。
text.en: removeItem in src/cart.js: removing an item not in the cart should do nothing; now it throws.

text.zh: 下面是 src/cart.js 的代码。total 算总价时漏掉了运费，请加上。
text.en: Here is the code of src/cart.js. total leaves shipping out of the total; please add it.

text.zh: 下面是 src/price.js 的代码。tax 把税率写死成 10%，应该从配置里读。
text.en: Here is the code of src/price.js. tax hard-codes a 10% rate; it should read the rate from the settings.

text.zh: src/price.js 的 tax：税额要四舍五入到分。
text.en: tax in src/price.js: the tax should be rounded to the cent.

text.zh: 会员结账打九折：src/price.js 的 discount 要认出会员，src/cart.js 的 total 要用上这个折扣。
text.en: Members get ten percent off at checkout: discount in src/price.js should know a member, and total in src/cart.js should apply it.

text.zh: 支持优惠券：src/cart.js 的 addItem 要能带一张券，src/price.js 的 discount 按券减价。
text.en: Support coupons: addItem in src/cart.js should take a coupon, and discount in src/price.js should take it off the price.

text.zh: 结账要改三处：src/cart.js 的 addItem 记下商品的税类，total 按税类分开加总，src/price.js 的 tax 按税类算。
text.en: Checkout needs three changes: addItem in src/cart.js keeps an item’s tax class, total adds up by tax class, and tax in src/price.js works by tax class.

title.en: Still signed in after signing out

text.zh: logout 没有清掉会话，退出以后刷新页面还是登录状态。
text.en: logout does not clear the session: after signing out, a reload still shows you signed in.

title.en: Upper and lower case in emails

text.en: login should ignore case in email addresses.

text.zh: discount 最多只能打到五折，现在叠加以后会出现负价格。
text.en: discount should take at most half off; stacked discounts now give negative prices.

title.en: The total of an empty cart

text.zh: 购物车是空的时候，total 应该是 0，现在是 NaN。
text.en: With an empty cart, total should be 0; now it is NaN.

text.zh: 支持退款：removeItem 退回已付的钱，tax 把退回部分的税也退掉。
text.en: Support refunds: removeItem pays back what was paid, and tax pays back the tax on it too.

text.zh: 有用户反馈：结账金额偶尔会是负数。
text.en: A user reports that the checkout total is sometimes negative.

title.zh: 换了账号还是原来的人
title.en: Switching accounts keeps the old one

text.zh: 有用户反馈：退出再用另一个账号登录，看到的还是原来账号的购物车。
text.en: A user reports that after signing out and in with another account, they still see the old account’s cart.

text.zh: 文章标题里有空格时，slugify 生成的链接打不开。
text.en: When a post title has spaces, the link slugify makes does not open.

text.zh: formatDate 要按读者所在的地区显示日期。
text.en: formatDate should show dates the way the reader’s region writes them.

text.zh: listPosts 要把最新的文章排在最前面。
text.en: listPosts should put the newest posts first.

text.zh: handle 遇到对方超时时要重试三次，现在直接丢掉。见 webhooks 包的测试。
text.en: handle should retry three times when the other side times out; now it drops the call. See the tests of the webhooks package.

title.en: It knows what you give it

t.zh: 就是编码 agent 里的那个大模型：读一段文字，给出一个动作。它读到的那段文字叫上下文。
t.en: is the large model inside a coding agent: it reads some text and gives one action. The text it reads is its context.

t.zh: 现在还没有任何机器替你跑它。你自己决定上下文里放什么，按下「调用」，看它做了什么，再自己跑测试。
t.en: No machine runs it for you yet. You decide what goes into the context, press Call, see what it did, and run the tests yourself.

after.zh: 没看到 addItem 的代码，模型照样写了：它编了一个仓库里不存在的函数。把文件放进上下文，它就写对了。模型只知道上下文里的东西；上下文外面的，它会编。
after.en: Without the code of addItem the model wrote anyway: it made up a function the repository does not have. With the file in its context, it wrote it right. The model knows only what is in its context; what is outside, it makes up.

brief.zh: 让模型修好这个 issue，再跑一次测试确认。
brief.en: Get the model to fix this issue, then run the tests to make sure.

hint.zh: 先不放文件，调用一次，看它写了什么，再跑测试。
hint.en: Call it once with no file, see what it writes, and run the tests.

hint.zh: issue 里写了要改的文件名。
hint.en: The issue names the file to change.

title.en: Give it what it asks for

after.zh: 一轮一轮：模型提要求，你去拿，结果放回上下文，再调用。它第一次写的看起来对，测试却没过；把失败的测试报告放回上下文，它就改对了。刚才你做的，就是一个 agent 循环：每一轮调用一次模型，做它要的事，把结果接回去。
after.en: Turn after turn: the model asks, you fetch, the result goes back into its context, and you call again. Its first try looked right and failed the tests; with the failing report in its context, it got it right. What you just did is an agent loop: each turn, one model call, do what it asks, feed the result back.

brief.zh: 这次模型会提要求：要目录、要文件。照着它的要求给，直到测试通过。
brief.en: This time the model asks: for the file list, for a file. Give it what it asks for, until the tests pass.

hint.zh: 模型要目录时，按目录按钮，把仓库的文件列表放进上下文。
hint.en: When the model asks for the files, press File list to put the repository’s list into its context.

hint.zh: 它说做完了，不一定真做完了。
hint.en: It says it is done; that does not make it done.

after.zh: 上下文有上限，叫窗口。超出的部分从最早的开始丢掉，而最早放进去的往往就是 issue 本身：模型看不到任务，就以为没事可做。放进上下文的东西不是越多越好，要挑。
after.en: A context has a limit, its window. What goes over is dropped from the oldest on, and the oldest is often the issue itself: a model that cannot see its task thinks there is nothing to do. More in the context is not better; pick.

brief.zh: 这个模型一次只能读 700 个 token。让它修好这个 issue。
brief.en: This model reads at most 700 tokens at a time. Get it to fix this issue.

hint.zh: 上下文条上变灰的部分，模型看不到。
hint.en: Whatever turns grey on the context bar, the model does not see.

hint.zh: issue 只写了函数名。每个文件里有哪些函数，仓库那一栏里写着。
hint.en: The issue names only the function. The repository panel shows which functions each file holds.

t.zh: 手动喂了几次模型以后，这一章开始搭机器。机器每次运行这块板一次：左边是它拿到的东西，右边是结果去的地方，中间由你接。
t.en: After feeding the model by hand, this chapter starts on the machine. It runs this board once: on the left what it is given, on the right where the results go; the middle is yours to wire.

t.zh: 这一章的模型只会被调用一次，不能回头要东西：它看到什么就写什么。这一关的 issue 自带了代码。
t.en: In this chapter the model is called once and cannot ask for anything: it writes from what it sees. This level’s issues come with their code.

showcase.zh: 第一块板：机器跑一遍板，左边是它拿到的，右边是结果去的地方，中间由玩家接；模型本身在纸笔一章里已经亲手调用过
showcase.en: the first board: the machine runs it once, what it is given on the left, where the results go on the right, the middle wired by the player; the model itself was called by hand in Pen and paper

after.zh: issue 里贴了代码，模型就看得到要改的函数，一次写对。板上线里流的是上下文：一组条目，每条占一些 token；模型读进一段上下文，给出一个动作。
after.en: With the code pasted into the issue, the model can see the function to change and writes it right in one go. What runs on these wires is context: a list of entries, each taking some tokens; the model reads a context and gives one action.

brief.zh: 搭一块板：把 issue 交给模型，它写出的修改落进仓库。
brief.en: Build a board: hand the issue to the model, and what it writes lands in the repository.

hint.zh: 从 issue 右边的圆点连到模型，再从模型连到仓库。
hint.en: Wire the dot on the right of the issue to the model, and the model to the repository.

t.zh: 只接 issue 的板，在这里会编出不存在的函数：代码不在模型的上下文里。模型只有一个输入口，两样东西要先并成一段。
t.en: A board wired with the issue alone makes up functions here: the code is not in the model’s context. The model has one input, so the two have to become one context first.

after.zh: 拼接把几段上下文按顺序接成一段。现在由你决定模型看到什么、按什么顺序看到。
after.en: Concat joins contexts into one, in order. Now you decide what the model sees, and in what order.

brief.zh: 这次 issue 没贴代码，代码单独给在左边。让模型两样都看到。
brief.en: This time the issue has no code; the code comes separately on the left. Let the model see both.

t.zh: 这一关的 issue 只写了要改哪个文件，代码要从仓库里拿。读文件元件按它的设置读出一个文件，作为一段上下文。
t.en: This level’s issues only say which file to change; the code has to come from the repository. The read part reads the file its setting names, as a context.

after.zh: 你替模型去仓库里拿了它要看的东西。哪个文件该读，现在是你在 issue 里找出来的。
after.en: You fetched from the repository what the model needed to see. Which file to read, you found in the issue yourself.

brief.zh: 没有人替你贴代码了。从仓库里读出要改的文件，交给模型。
brief.en: Nobody pastes the code for you now. Read the file to change from the repository and hand it to the model.

t.zh: 和<level-ref to="1-3"></level-ref>一样的事，多了一个维度：一处修改要看的文件多了一个。
t.en: The same as <level-ref to="1-3"></level-ref>, one dimension more: the change needs one more file in view.

after.zh: 每处修改的代码都要在上下文里。少了一个文件，那一处就是编的。
after.en: Every change needs its code in the context. One file short, and that change is made up.

brief.zh: 这次一个 issue 要改两个文件。
brief.en: This time one issue changes two files.

t.zh: 全部读进去，窗口装不下：最早放进去的会被丢掉。要从函数名找到它所在的文件。
t.en: Read everything in and the window cannot hold it: the oldest entries are dropped. Find the file a function lives in from its name.

after.zh: 窗口有限时，读对一个文件胜过读全部。上下文的顺序也算数：窗口从最早的那头开始丢。
after.en: With a limited window, the right file beats every file. The order counts too: the window drops from the oldest end.

brief.zh: 这个仓库的文件都很长，模型的窗口是 1000 个 token。issue 只写了函数名。
brief.en: This repository’s files are long, and the model’s window is 1000 tokens. The issues name only the function.

hint.zh: 测试区里列着仓库的每个文件和它的函数。
hint.en: The test area lists every file of the repository with its functions.

t.zh: 一次调用要写完三处：每一处的代码都要在它眼前。
t.en: One call has to write all three: each one’s code must be in front of it.

after.zh: 一次调用能写好几处，前提是要看的都在上下文里。到这里，挑文件、拼上下文的都是你：模型自己不能要东西。
after.en: One call can write several changes, as long as all it needs is in its context. So far, picking the files and building the context is all yours: the model cannot ask for anything itself.

brief.zh: 一个 issue，三处修改，两个文件。
brief.en: One issue, three changes, two files.

t.zh: 上一章的机器只调用一次模型，读哪个文件得你事先选好。这一章的机器每一轮都跑一遍这块板：模型这一轮给的动作，可以接到读文件元件上，读出来的东西接到「留到下一轮」，下一轮就出现在左边的「历史」里。
t.en: Last chapter’s machine called the model once, and you picked the file beforehand. This chapter’s machine runs the board every turn: the action the model gives this turn can go into the read part, what it reads goes into Keep for next turn, and next turn it shows up in History on the left.

t.zh: 机器会自己把模型每一轮的动作记进历史。模型的修改落进仓库；什么时候停，看接到「停」的是什么。
t.en: The machine records the model’s action each turn in the history itself. Its writes land in the repository; when to stop depends on what you wire into Stop.

after.zh: 读哪个文件，由模型这一轮的动作决定，不再是板上写死的设置。issue、历史、模型、工具、留到下一轮：这就是 agent 循环的骨架，转起来的是机器。
after.en: Which file to read is now up to the model’s action this turn, not a setting fixed on the board. Issue, history, model, tools, keep for next turn: that is the skeleton of an agent loop, and the machine turns it.

brief.zh: 这次机器一轮一轮地跑这块板。让模型自己要文件、自己读，改完就停。
brief.en: Now the machine runs this board turn after turn. Let the model ask for files and read them itself, and stop when it is done.

hint.zh: 读文件元件的输入口接上模型的动作，它就读模型要的那个文件。
hint.en: With the model’s action wired into the read part’s input, it reads the file the model asks for.

hint.zh: 模型下一轮要看到的东西：issue，还有之前每一轮发生的事。
hint.en: What the model needs to see next turn: the issue, and what happened in every turn before.

t.zh: 只会读文件的板，在这里卡住：模型不知道该读哪个，就要一份目录，可没有元件回应它。新元件<part-ref to="part:list"></part-ref>在模型要目录时，给出仓库的文件和每个文件里的函数。
t.en: A board that can only read gets stuck here: not knowing what to read, the model asks for the file list, and nothing answers. The new part <part-ref to="part:list"></part-ref> gives the repository’s files and the functions in each when the model asks for it.

after.zh: 模型先看目录，再读文件，再改：它用的工具越多，你要事先知道的越少。每个工具的结果都要接回去，它才看得到。
after.en: The model looked at the list, read the file, then changed it: the more tools it has, the less you need to know beforehand. Every tool’s result has to be fed back for it to see.

brief.zh: 这些 issue 只写了函数名。让模型自己找到它在哪个文件里。
brief.en: These issues name only the function. Let the model find which file it is in.

t.zh: 模型写完自己以为该写的，就说「做完了」，不管测试。新元件<part-ref to="part:test"></part-ref>在模型说做完或要求测试时跑一遍测试：给出一份报告，和测试是否通过。
t.en: Once the model has written what it thinks it should, it says it is done, tests or not. The new part <part-ref to="part:test"></part-ref> runs the tests when the model says it is done or asks for them: it gives a report, and whether the tests pass.

after.zh: 模型说做完了，不等于做完了。把「停」交给测试，模型的话就要被检查；失败的报告接回上下文，它下一轮就照着改。
after.en: The model saying it is done does not make it done. Hand Stop to the tests and its word gets checked; a failing report fed back into its context is what it fixes by next turn.

brief.zh: 这两个 issue 的改法容易写错。让机器改到测试通过才停。
brief.en: These two issues are easy to get wrong. Have the machine go on until the tests pass.

hint.zh: 先用之前的停法跑一次，看最后一轮测试是什么样。
hint.en: Run it once with the old way of stopping, and look at the tests after the last turn.
Stop also takes a pass flag.

t.zh: 和<level-ref to="2-3"></level-ref>一样的机器，多一层：要转更多轮，测试报告里一次失败两处。
t.en: The same machine as <level-ref to="2-3"></level-ref>, one level deeper: more turns, and a report that fails two changes at once.

after.zh: 一份报告列出所有失败，模型每一轮修它看得到的那些。轮数多了，历史也跟着变长。
after.en: One report lists every failure, and each turn the model fixes the ones it can see. More turns, and a longer history.

brief.zh: 一个 issue，两处容易写错的修改，在两个文件里。
brief.en: One issue, two easy-to-get-wrong changes, in two files.

t.zh: 少一层支架：issue 里没有函数名，也没有文件名。模型要先知道哪里坏了。
t.en: One support less: no function and no file in the issue. The model first has to find out what is broken.

after.zh: 只有症状时，失败的测试就是线索：报告里写着哪里不对。同一块板，issue 写得越少，越靠工具把信息找回来。
after.en: With only a symptom, a failing test is the lead: the report says what is wrong where. On the same board, the less the issue says, the more the tools have to find.

brief.zh: 这些 issue 只写了用户看到的问题，没说改哪里。
brief.en: These issues describe only what users see, not what to change.

hint.zh: 模型不知道从哪改的时候，会先要求跑测试。
hint.en: When the model does not know where to start, it asks for the tests first.

t.zh: 只写函数名的、有陷阱的、只说症状的，一块板全部接住。
t.en: Named by function, with a trap, or only a symptom: one board takes them all.

after.zh: 一块板接住了三种 issue：要目录、读文件、跑测试、改到通过。这就是一个完整的编码 agent：一个循环，一个上下文，几个工具，一道检查。
after.en: One board took all three kinds: list, read, test, fix until it passes. That is a whole coding agent: a loop, a context, a few tools and a check.

brief.zh: 三种 issue 混在一起，每个都要在 10 轮内改好并停下。
brief.en: Three kinds of issue mixed, each fixed and stopped within 10 turns.

after.zh: 目录一旦进了历史，之后每一轮都要再读一遍。没有元件回应它的要目录，模型就换一条路：跑测试，从失败报告里找到文件。给模型的工具少一个，有时反而更省。
after.en: Once the list is in the history, every later turn reads it again. With nothing to answer its ask for the list, the model takes another way: it runs the tests and finds the file in the failing report. One tool fewer is sometimes cheaper.

brief.zh: 三十多个包的仓库，光目录就很长。修好这个 issue，总共不超过 2000 个 token。
brief.en: A repository of over thirty packages, whose file list alone is long. Fix this issue in 2000 tokens all told.

hint.zh: 模型的每次调用都要读一遍整个上下文。
hint.en: Every call of the model reads its whole context again.

body.zh: 真实的大模型每次回答都可能不同，调用要花钱，也没法把所有情况测一遍，所以游戏里的模型是一个按规则行事的替身。它的规则写在元件说明里，每一条都对应真实模型的一种表现：只知道上下文里的东西，没看到的会编，窗口有限，第一次写容易错的地方会写错，写完就说做完了。
body.en: A real large model may answer differently each time, costs money to call, and cannot be tested on every case, so the model in this game is a stand-in that follows rules. Its rules are in its part description, and each is something real models do: it knows only what is in its context, makes up what it has not seen, has a limited window, gets tricky changes wrong on the first try, and says it is done once it has written what it meant to.

body.zh: 游戏里的「代码」也是简化的：一个文件就是几个有名字的函数，改对、改错、编造各算一种结果。这里练的是模型外面那一层：给它看什么、让它做什么、怎么检查它。
body.en: The code is simplified too: a file is a few named functions, and a change is right, wrong or made up. What you practise here is the layer around the model: what it sees, what it may do, and how it is checked.

body.zh: 模型每次调用读进的那一段文字：任务、代码、之前发生的事。模型对世界的了解只有这么多；不在上下文里的东西，对它来说就不存在。
body.en: The text a model reads on each call: the task, the code, what happened before. That is all it knows of the world; whatever is not in its context does not exist for it.

body.zh: 上下文按 token 计算长度，一个 token 大约是一个英文单词的四分之三，或者半个到一个汉字。每次调用，整段上下文都要重新读一遍，按 token 收费。
body.en: A context is measured in tokens; a token is about three quarters of an English word, or half to one Chinese character. Every call reads the whole context again, and is billed by the token.

body.zh: 模型被要求写它没看过的代码时，往往不会说「我没看到」，而是写出一段看起来合理的代码：调用一个名字很像、但并不存在的函数，或者猜错参数。这常被叫作「幻觉」。办法不是叮嘱它别编，而是把它需要的东西放进上下文，或者给它自己去拿的工具。
body.en: Asked to write code it has not seen, a model will seldom say so; it writes something that looks reasonable instead: a call to a function with a likely name that does not exist, or the wrong arguments. This is often called hallucination. The cure is not to tell it not to, but to put what it needs into its context, or to give it tools to fetch it.

body.zh: 一个模型一次能读的上下文有上限，叫上下文窗口。超出的部分要么被截掉，要么根本放不进去。在这个游戏里，超出窗口的条目从最早的开始丢掉，模型不会知道丢了什么。
body.en: The context a model can read at once has a limit, its context window. Whatever goes over is cut off or never gets in. In this game, entries over the window are dropped from the oldest on, and the model does not know what was lost.

body.zh: 真实的窗口很大，但长上下文更贵、更慢，而且模型对中间部分的注意也会变差。所以挑选放进去的东西，在窗口很大时同样重要。
body.en: Real windows are large, but long contexts are dearer and slower, and models attend less well to the middle. Choosing what goes in matters even with a large window.

body.zh: 编码 agent 的核心是一个循环：把任务和之前的历史交给模型；模型给出一个动作（读文件、跑命令、改代码、宣布完成）；执行这个动作，把结果记进历史；再来一轮。直到模型说做完了，或者某个检查说可以停了。
body.en: At the heart of a coding agent is a loop: hand the model the task and the history so far; it gives one action (read a file, run a command, edit code, say it is done); carry the action out and record the result in the history; go round again. Until the model says it is done, or a check says it may stop.

body.zh: 真实的 agent 程序只有几百行，大部分是在拼上下文、执行工具、处理结果。
body.en: A real agent program is a few hundred lines, most of them building the context, running tools and handling results.

body.zh: 模型自己只能输出文字。工具是 agent 程序替它执行的动作：读文件、列目录、搜索、跑测试、改代码。模型说「我要读 src/cart.js」，程序去读，再把内容放进下一轮的上下文。有了工具，模型可以自己去拿它需要的东西，不用人事先猜好。
body.en: A model by itself only writes text. Tools are the actions the agent program carries out for it: read a file, list a directory, search, run the tests, edit the code. The model says “I want to read src/cart.js”; the program reads it and puts the content into the next turn’s context. With tools, the model fetches what it needs instead of someone guessing it beforehand.

body.zh: 模型说「做完了」只是它的判断。可靠的 agent 不把这句话当作结束的条件，而是用测试、类型检查、构建这样能自动判定的东西来决定能不能停，并把失败的结果交还给模型去改。
body.en: A model saying it is done is only its judgement. A reliable agent does not take that as the end; it lets something that can decide by itself (tests, a type check, a build) say whether to stop, and hands failures back to the model to fix.
